description:
Kill a working specialist and all the work it is doing.

Name the specialist by its ID. It stops at its next safe point. When it has submitted an order, applied a payment or entered a sign-in whose outcome is not confirmed yet, it confirms that outcome first. A payment or sign-in card the user has not answered is withdrawn. Killing it does not undo anything it already did. A specialist another one called, such as the login a checkout called, can be killed too; its caller gets its stopped result, which says you stopped it, and carries on.

status.description: Use draft while gathering terms, or ready to request payment after Muse has confirmed the cart. An empty card form can be ready when a card is available to enter or preparation will supply one. Omission records a draft; a call with only tab reads wallet availability.

record_only.description: Record the purchase without requesting payment. Defaults to false.

summary.description: Describe the purchase, its terms and any open questions, including contents, options, delivery, account details and commitments. When recording an outcome, explain what the merchant shows.

merchant_name.description: The merchant name shown on the page. Omit when not shown.

line_item_names.description: Names of the purchased items for Link. Shop Pay can supply these through line_items.

final_amount_minor.description: Amount due now in the currency's minor units, which depend on its decimal places: 2599 for USD 25.99, 19800 for JPY 19,800 (the yen is its smallest unit), 12345 for KWD 12.345. Keep additional conditional charges separate.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, such as USD.

conditional_amount_minor.description: Maximum additional conditional charge for the whole purchase, in the same minor units. Explain the conditions in summary. Omit when none applies.

payment_route.description: The merchant's payment route. Use none only when no payment method is required; a draft or record_only call still records the route the checkout needs.

payment_method.description: The page's wording, including any explanation that this does not apply. Omit when not shown.

use_wallet.description: When Muse has not selected a wallet card: true offers the available wallet; false uses the supplied or entered card. Null or omission keeps this checkout's choice, defaulting to false. A later payment choice from Muse replaces it.

payment_credential_valid_for_seconds.description: Requested Link card lifetime after approval, in seconds; null uses the default. Keep the same duration unless payment timing changes.

merchant_country.description: For Shop Pay, the merchant's two-letter country code.

line_items.description: For Shop Pay. Supply each line's name, quantity and a unit price or line total before requesting payment. Prices are in the currency's minor units, like final_amount_minor.

shipping_address.description: For Shop Pay. A partial address can be recorded while gathering terms; complete it before requesting payment.

outcome.description: What the merchant shows about the order. Explain the evidence in summary.

confirmation.description: The merchant's order or booking confirmation, including its identifier when shown.
